title: Research consolidation: bind PR116 evidence-only head to tested sources (no new kappa)
body:
PR116's ledger asks reviewers to investigate a changed head, while the round-eight review says the increment only adds verification evidence. This consolidation resolves that source question and preserves the remaining mathematical review. **No new κ; no selected-frontier change.**

An independent standard-library checker decodes 208 anchored Git objects and compares both complete trees (1,559 → 1,560 tracked paths). Exactly three paths change: README status, its SOURCE hash, and an added author receipt. All 41 scientific/dependency objects retain identical Git IDs and modes; the historical certificate retains `49349675169/500000000000000`.

Fresh GitHub reads corroborate all 42 historical check records. The three focused Python jobs actually checked out synthetic merge `0db8566d07ae1fd7765d5d98fbb32ad22775ed32`; its complete tree equals historical research head `97750ec74fc714638c0aa4f31aaa880e56cb8b4d`. This explicitly binds the checkout instead of treating a check's associated `head_sha` as its checkout. The evidence-only head is `295a48a3b966428896057a98c6b4834c0b4b7416`.

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/pr116-evidence-reconciliation/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/pr116-evidence-reconciliation/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_PR116_EVIDENCE_RECONCILIATION changed_paths=3 unchanged_dependencies=41 checks=42 focused_jobs=3`, followed by 28 passing tests, including 26 corruption controls. Offline relocation on Python 3.9.6, Python 3.14.6, byte-identical regeneration, selected-record verification, five selected tests, 14 ledger tests, the complete 642-entry reconciliation checker and whitespace checks pass.

Scope: source identity and recovered historical CI evidence, not a fresh mathematical replay or maintainer acceptance. The author's standalone 3,733-second local archive was not recovered; only its receipt is retained. Full `make verify`, supplier cold replay and Lean compilation were not rerun. Only PR116's ledger question and companion link change; its disposition stays `changed_since_review`.

Research base `8bddbee377e2f3ce1f1247196c4b290d55767d20`; rebased and checked against `2921874911956718fcaaaf9396fe8267b3cfa9f0`. Package README, CLAIM and VALIDATION record source pins, completed coverage, limitations and overlap. Seed 96, research consolidation; no pinned coordination issue was available. One overlap-driven pivot avoided duplicating PR828. No competing PR116 reconciliation found before submission.

Credit: Rohan Arun's PR116 and validation receipt; Douglas Colkitt's earlier round-eight observation; icekylinx, eumemic, Avi Eisenberg, Rohan Gupta, Swapnil Jain and the inherited lineage retain attribution. Ross Richardson prepared this package with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0. `upstream/` remains unchanged. `codex` and `codex-automation` labels are unavailable upstream.
